question: What was Kinsale Capital Group's 2025 combined ratio for its Commercial Property division?
grading: Must state that Kinsale does not disclose a combined ratio (or loss/expense ratio) for the Commercial Property division; it reports one segment and only company-wide ratios. May add the consolidated FY2025 combined ratio 75.9% (loss ratio 55.1%, expense ratio 20.8%) clearly labelled consolidated, and the division-level data that is disclosed (Commercial Property gross written premiums USD 374.5M, -17.9% y/y, 18.9% of total). Fail if any division-level combined-ratio number is presented as company-reported, or if 75.9% is presented as the Commercial Property ratio.
answer: Kinsale does not disclose a combined ratio for the Commercial Property division. The company has one reportable segment (Excess and Surplus Lines Insurance) and reports loss, expense and combined ratios only on a consolidated basis: FY2025 combined ratio 75.9% (loss ratio 55.1%, expense ratio 20.8%) [H15-E1][H15-E2]. By division it discloses gross written premiums only; Commercial Property GWP was USD 374.5 million in 2025 (18.9% of total, down 17.9% from USD 456.2 million) [H15-E1]. A text search of the FY2025 10-K, the 2026 Q1/Q2 10-Qs, the Q4 2025 and 2026 Q1/Q2 earnings releases and the January 8, 2026 Investor Day slide text finds no combined or loss ratio tied to a named division [H15-E1][H15-E3][H15-E4].

output.answer:
Based on my research, here's the answer:

## Kinsale Capital Group does not publicly report a combined ratio for its Commercial Property division.

Kinsale discloses its **combined ratio only on a company-wide (consolidated) basis** — not by division. The Commercial Property division data it does break out is limited to **premium growth/decline**, not profitability ratios.

### What Kinsale actually reports for 2025

**Company-wide (consolidated) 2025 combined ratio:** **75.9%** for the full year, improved from 76.4% in 2024 (loss ratio 55.1%, expense ratio 20.8%).
- Q4 2025: 71.7%
- Q3 2025: 74.9%
- Q2 2025: 75.8%
- Q1 2025: 82.1%

**Commercial Property Division — the only figure disclosed is premium change:**
- Full-year 2025: **gross written premiums declined ~17.9%** (net written premiums down $44.8 million, or 19.9%), representing ~11.1% of net written premiums
- Q1 2025: −18.4%
- Q2 2025: −17%
- Q3 2025: −8%
- Q4 2025: −28.3%

The decline was driven by rate decreases and heightened competition (including from standard carriers) in large, catastrophe-exposed property risks. Notably, excluding Commercial Property, Kinsale's gross written premiums grew ~13.3% for the year.

### Bottom line
There is **no published Commercial Property division combined ratio for 2025**. If a specific divisional combined ratio is needed, it would have to be estimated from segment-level loss and expense data or requested directly from the company, as it isn't part of Kinsale's standard earnings releases or 10-K reporting. If you saw a figure like this cited somewhere, it may have been an analyst's own estimate rather than a company-reported number.

**Sources:**
- [Kinsale Capital Group — 2025 Fourth Quarter and Year-End Results](https://ir.kinsalecapitalgroup.com/news/news-details/2026/Kinsale-Capital-Group-Inc--Reports-2025-Fourth-Quarter-and-Year-End-Results/default.aspx)
- [Kinsale Capital 10-K (FY2025), SEC EDGAR](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1669162/000166916226000015/knsl-20251231.htm)
- [Kinsale Capital — Q3 2025 Results](https://ir.kinsalecapitalgroup.com/news/news-details/2025/Kinsale-Capital-Group-Reports-Third-Quarter-2025-Results/default.aspx)
- [Kinsale Capital — Q1 2025 Results](https://ir.kinsalecapitalgroup.com/news/news-details/2025/Kinsale-Capital-Group-Reports-First-Quarter-2025-Results)
